d:
Join Veggie Paaji on an epic night street food tour in Patna, Bihar! We're exploring the famous Gandhi Maidan food scene and Fraser Road to bring you the best and most authentic Patna food.
In this episode of our Bihar food series, we dive deep into the heart of Patna's night street food culture. From savory chats and crispy snacks to unique Bihari sweets, Patna has it all. We start our food tour at Gandhi Maidan, trying traditional Bihari snacks, and then move to Fraser road for some more delicious fried items and famous sweets.
